svg.title: Festio Juniors complete workflow: daily arrival, screening, every return and verified pickup

text.tspan: Every child accounted for. Every handoff recorded.
DAY 0: Platform check-in. FROM DAY 1: Daily JP drop-off.
Review both needs at daily drop-off.
WRISTBANDS: Standard for every child · Extra bands for allergy and accommodation · Confirm daily
Every departure includes a recorded return

Guardian updates at every recorded step
Email and SMS keep guardians informed.
Add or correct child and guardian details.
Record items issued, destinations and returns.
VOLUNTEERS KEEP EVERY HANDOFF SAFE AND SMOOTH TO PREVENT OVERCROWDING
